entities.summary: The Port of Nakhodka is a Russian seaport of federal importance located in Nakhodka Bay, on the northwestern coast of the Sea of Japan. It forms part of one of Russia's largest transport hubs on the Pacific Ocean, together with the Vostochny Port. In 2020, the port's total cargo volume reached 26.8 million tons. It is situated in the city of Nakhodka, Primorsky Krai, in the Russian Far East.
